purpose: Determine whether universal, formula-neutral nonlinear solver controls remove the two P0724 fine-grid AQUAL nonconvergences without changing the field equation or physical parameters.
selectionPolicy: Among variants that converge both galaxies, meet residual/update gates, and agree with at least one other successful variant, select the smallest median wall time. Observational fit must not select solver controls.
rethinkPolicy: If fewer than two universal variants converge both systems and agree, do not raise the iteration cap as the sole remedy. Replace or augment Picard iteration with continuation, Anderson/Newton-Krylov, multigrid, or a preconditioned nonlinear method and preregister a new stage.
claimBoundary: DDO53 and DDO101 were selected because their P0724 fine-grid AQUAL solves failed; they are numerical debugging systems, not scientific holdouts.
Every variant keeps the AQUAL equation, G, a0, density volume, grid, boundary, observation target, and coefficient floor fixed.
Initialization and damping are numerical controls, not galaxy or gravity parameters, and one setting must apply to both galaxies.
Convergence and cross-method solution agreement select a solver; circular-speed agreement with observed data does not.
A successful result validates numerical robustness on these two inputs only and does not validate AQUAL as a theory.
